# FTT { #deep_tensor.FTT }

```python
FTT(
    self,
    bases: ApproxBases,
    tt: TT | None = None,
    num_error_samples: int = 1000,
)
```

A functional tensor train.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**bases**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [ApproxBases]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A set of basis functions for each dimension of the FTT.

<code>[**tt**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [TT \| None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   A tensor train object.

<code>[**num_error_samples**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [1000]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   The number of samples to use to estimate the $L_{2}$ error of  the FTT during its construction.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [approximate](#deep_tensor.FTT.approximate) | Constructs a FTT approximation to a target function. |
| [eval](#deep_tensor.FTT.eval) | Evaluates the FTT. |

### approximate { #deep_tensor.FTT.approximate }

```python
FTT.approximate(
    target_func: Callable[[Tensor], Tensor],
    reference: Reference | None = None,
)
```

Constructs a FTT approximation to a target function.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**target_func**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [Callable\[\[Tensor\], Tensor\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The target function, $f : [-1, 1]^{d} \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$.

### eval { #deep_tensor.FTT.eval }

```python
FTT.eval(ls: Tensor, direction: Direction | None = None)
```

Evaluates the FTT.

Returns the functional tensor train approximation to the target 
function for either the first or last $k$ variables, for a set 
of points mapped to the domain of the basis functions.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**ls**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [Tensor]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   An $n \times d$ matrix containing a set of samples mapped  to the domain of the FTT basis functions.

<code>[**direction**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [Direction \| None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   The direction in which to iterate over the cores.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[**Gs_prod**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [Tensor]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   An $n \times n_{k}$ matrix, where each row contains the  product of the first or last (depending on direction) $k$  tensor cores evaluated at the corresponding sample in `ls`.
